blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is looking to use its regulated partnership in the Philippines as a model for other global platforms entering the local market. In a statement, Binance Philippines general manager Jen Bilango stated that their compliance work with the Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) Strategic Sandbox (StratBox) could help set standards for foreign crypto exchanges. crypto exchanges.
